Source of record; ROUND2_FINDING_REGISTER.md is RENDERED from this file by render_round2_register.py and every statistic in it is derived, never typed. Author 1.0.0_SA_CTO~X, 2026-08-28. Fields per the GPT memorandum sec 4.3 (org/tier1_exec/1.0.0_SA_CTO/deliverables/D11_GPT_ISCK_STATUS_ASSESSMENT_20260828/). source_ref = broker Msg-ID where the sender was a registered seat; 4.0.0_SA_CRO~X is a Codex seat whose messages carry no Msg-ID, so its refs are the inbox timestamp (UTC) of the file in org/mcp/inbox/1.0.0_SA_CTO/~X/read/. OPEN-CITATION = the disposition is recorded in BOUNDARY_ROUND2.md but the exact fixing commit was not re-derived for this register; OPEN-CLAIM-TEXT = the origin message was not re-read in full for this register. Both are honest gaps, not closures.

classes.CHARTER-GAP: a gap in the round-2 charter's scope, raised pre-charter (Andrew-supplied CRO~X review)
classes.CONTRACT: a defect in ISCK_CONTRACT.md / the schema / the validator at a cited tip
classes.DESIGN-INPUT: a defect or required input against the R2-2 design draft (attacked-dry, landing carried)
classes.BATTERY: a defect in the gate suite / probes / runner (R2-9)
classes.RECORD: a false or unauditable claim in a governed record (boundary record, disposition, commit message)
classes.PROCESS: a defect in how the round was run (tree atomicity, lane gates, write halves)
classes.VERIFIER-SELF: a verifier's own false verdict, self-corrected on the record

dispositions.FIXED: artifact changed at fix_commit; verification_ref names the second seat's read
dispositions.FIXED-IN-DESIGN: R2-2 design draft amended; the schema change itself is carried to the R2-2 landing
dispositions.RESOLVED-BY-DESIGN-CARRIED: resolved by the R2-2 design; lands with the R2-2 landing checklist line named in disposition_basis
dispositions.AMENDED-RECORD: the governed record was amended (first-printed value kept beside the measured one)
dispositions.DISCLOSED-NO-CHANGE: disclosed on the record; no artifact change was the right remedy
dispositions.SELF-REFUTED: the attacker refuted its own claim before or at filing (re-run through the full instrument)
dispositions.SELF-CORRECTED: a verifier retracted its own verdict on the record
dispositions.RESOLVED-BY-THIS-REGISTER: the finding asked for exactly this artifact
